_meta.description: STANDARD compressor calibration anchors – StudioLive 32R, live simultaneous dump + UC Surface readback
_meta.displayReadbackMethod: UC Surface manual readback by user while dump was in progress
notes: All raw values are ZLIB scene-stored values extracted from the mixer dump.
Display values were read simultaneously from UC Surface (32R Ch11 Fat Channel panel).
32R was used in parallel probe session with UC Control closed — live PV events confirmed for this device.
All ZLIB values are expected to reflect the CURRENT physical knob positions (live state).
comp.attack raw=1.0 means attack knob at maximum (fully right).

anchors.notes: raw=0 (minimum) → -56 dBFS. Exactly confirms (raw-1)*56 formula at the minimum endpoint for 32R. Floor = -56 dBFS for 32R STANDARD comp.
raw=0 (minimum) → 1.0:1 (no compression). Exactly confirms formula minimum endpoint.
raw=1.0 (maximum attack knob) → 150ms. Phase 1 formula completely wrong (predicts 5947ms). Cross-device 2-point fit: 150*raw^1.161. Maximum attack time = 150ms confirmed for 32R.
Extremely close match (0.005% error). Strongly confirms formula: 2.5+897.5*raw^2.605.
1.4% error (0.13 dB). Approximately confirms formula: raw*27.6.
